summary: Clone RegExp pattern/flags when construction requires a new RegExp object.

target.notes: Construction copies original source and, when flags are omitted, original flags, but does not copy lastIndex.

caveats: For RegExp-like objects classified through Symbol.match, source and flags may be dynamic properties rather than internal slots.

tests.name: clone resets lastIndex
tests.input: const r=/a/g; r.lastIndex=7; const c=new RegExp(r); console.log(c===r,c.flags,c.lastIndex);

tests.name: explicit flags replace source flags
tests.input: const r=/a/g; const c=new RegExp(r,'i'); console.log(c.source,c.flags);
